title: #21 Industrialization
prompt: In the 18th century due to industrialization, a lot of people migrated to developed countries. This affected lifestyle and increased problems in developed countries. What is your opinion about this?

promptSegments.text: In the 18th century due to industrialization, a lot of people migrated to developed countries.
This affected lifestyle and increased problems in developed countries.
